title: Application are invited for 31st Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 18th to 22nd November 2024
bodyHtml:
Application are invited for 31st Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 18th to 22nd November 2024
Mode: Online
Registration Fee: Rs. 1000/-
Last Date of Registration: 12th November 2024
Organized By: National Coordination Centre- Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
Online Registration Link:31st Skill Development Programme (SDP) on Pharmacovigilance (google.com) (opens in a new tab)
